title: 飛行力学(再履修クラス)
subtitle: Dynamics of Flight
educationalGoal: The “dynamics of flight” is the foundation of aeronautical engineering. In this course, students will learn what kind of forces act on an aircraft in flight and learn about the balance and dynamics characteristics for stable flight.
advice: Students will begin by learning basic mathematical knowledge and axis definitions, and learn about the six-degrees-of-freedom equation of motion. Next, students will learn to analyze qualities of flight after learning linearization of the equation of motion. In addition to learning design standards, students will deepen their understanding of qualities of flight by learning the basics of flight control.
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of Dynamics of Machines Sufficient skill in mathematics and physics

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the principles of flight and its characteristics.
Be able to consider motion mode characteristics by applying equations of motion.
Be able to understand the effects on flight motion of changes in the aerodynamic derivative acting.
Be able to understand the outline of the flight control system.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Be able to accurately explain the physical principles and characteristics of aircraft in flight. (2) Understand the equations of motion that describe motion in flight, and be able to explain the mode of motion through actual examples. (3) Be able to explain the effects of the main items of the aerodynamic derivative on flight motion by showing numerical values through examples. (4) Understand the role of flight control systems in aircraft motion and be able to explain its effectiveness concretely.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the principle of flight and its characteristics, and be able to explain important items. (2) Understand the equations of motion that describe motion in flight, and be able to explain the results while looking at the text. (3) Be able to explain the effects of the main items of the aerodynamic derivative on flight motion shown by related expressions in the text, and to explain the results while looking at the text. (4) Understand the role of the flight control system in aircraft motion and be able to explain its necessity.
